description: This file implements WebSocket-based communication for a gateway channel, including protocol definitions, connection management, authentication handling, message encoding/decoding, and reconnection logic in Swift for an iOS/macOS app.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: Protocol defining the WebSocket task operations, such as resume, cancel, send, and receive.

classes.name: WebSocketSessioning
classes.description: Protocol for WebSocket session creation, allowing for dependency injection and mocking.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: Wrapper around WebSocketTasking for additional convenience and thread safety.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: Holds a WebSocketSessioning instance, used to abstract and inject dependencies.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for connecting to the gateway, including role, scopes, capabilities, permissions, client info, and device identity inclusion.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: Enumeration of possible authentication sources, such as device token, shared token, bootstrap token, password, or none.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: Actor managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, including connection, reconnections, authentication, message handling, and heartbeats.

calls: try await self.handleConnectResponse(response, identity: identity, role: role)
